result.instructions: Tools for Buttondown, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many subscribers do I have and who joined this week?"; "How did my last newsletter perform on opens and clicks?"; "Which drafts and scheduled emails do I have right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Buttondown data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run buttondown_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run buttondown_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run buttondown_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. buttondown_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: buttondown_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Buttondown account this API key belongs to: username and e-mail address. GET /accounts/me.

tools.name: buttondown_list_newsletters
tools.title: List newsletters
tools.description: List the newsletters on the account with name, username, domains, sender, locale and timezone. The newsletter's API key, custom CSS and e-mail templates are never returned. GET /newsletters.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_get_newsletter
tools.title: Get newsletter
tools.description: One newsletter by id (settings and identity only; no API key, CSS or templates). GET /newsletters/{id}.

newsletter_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

tools.name: buttondown_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List or search subscribers (newest first by default) with e-mail, type (regular, unactivated, unsubscribed, premium, ...), tags, notes, metadata, source, open/click rates and dates. Filter by e-mail text, type, tag, signup date or domain. GET /subscribers.

email_address.description: Only subscribers whose e-mail address contains this text.

type.description: Only subscribers of these types (e.g. regular, unactivated, unsubscribed).

tag.description: Only subscribers with these tag names.

domain.description: Only subscribers whose e-mail domain is one of these.

created_after.description: Only subscribers created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Only subscribers created before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: One subscriber by id or by e-mail address: type, tags, notes, metadata, source, engagement and lifecycle dates. GET /subscribers/{id_or_email}.

id_or_email.description: The subscriber's id or e-mail address.

tools.name: buttondown_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add ONE subscriber by e-mail address. No subscriber type is set, so Buttondown applies the newsletter's normal sign-up rules (double opt-in: the subscriber is typically created as unactivated and Buttondown e-mails THAT ONE address a confirmation message; opt-in is never bypassed, nor is the firewall). Only add people who asked to subscribe. Creating a subscriber (and its tags) can also start the newsletter's own automations, which may e-mail that one subscriber. An existing e-mail is left untouched (error, no overwrite). Optional tags (a tag that does not exist is created, which needs a plan with tags), a private note and metadata. Buttondown limits creation to 100 subscribers per day. POST /subscribers.

email_address.description: The new subscriber's e-mail address. They receive the confirmation e-mail.

notes.description: Private note (never shown to the subscriber).

metadata.description: Free-form key-value data stored on the subscriber.

tools.name: buttondown_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber's tags, notes or metadata
tools.description: WRITE: change ONE subscriber's tags, private note or metadata. Tags are merged (add_tags / remove_tags change only those names; the others stay). A given note or metadata replaces the existing value (destructive for that field). The subscriber's type (unsubscribe, block, ...) and e-mail address cannot be changed here, and this tool sends nothing itself; but a tag, note or metadata change can start the newsletter's own automations (for example a tag-triggered welcome sequence), which may e-mail that one subscriber. PATCH /subscribers/{id_or_email}.

id_or_email.description: The subscriber's id or e-mail address.

notes.description: Replace the private note with this text (empty string clears it).

metadata.description: Replace the subscriber's metadata object with this one.

tools.name: buttondown_list_emails
tools.title: List emails
tools.description: List emails (drafts, scheduled and sent), newest first by default, with subject, status, publish date, slug, archive URL and analytics summary. The body is left out unless include_body is set. Filter by status, subject text or date. GET /emails.

status.description: Only emails with these statuses (draft, scheduled, sent, ...).

subject.description: Only emails whose subject contains this text.

created_after.description: Only emails created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

created_before.description: Only emails created before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

published_after.description: Only emails published on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

published_before.description: Only emails published before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

include_body.description: Include each email's full body (large). Default false.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_get_email
tools.title: Get email
tools.description: One email by id with its full body, subject, status, publish date, slug, archive settings and analytics summary. GET /emails/{id}.

email_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

tools.name: buttondown_get_email_analytics
tools.title: Get email analytics
tools.description: Delivery and engagement numbers for one sent email: recipients, deliveries, opens, clicks, failures, unsubscriptions, complaints, replies, page views. GET /emails/{id}/analytics.

email_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

tools.name: buttondown_create_email_draft
tools.title: Create an email draft
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT email (status always "draft"). Nothing is sent or scheduled and no subscriber is e-mailed; to send it, the user must open the draft in Buttondown and send it there. This server has no tool that sends or schedules email. Body is Markdown or HTML. POST /emails.

description.description: Short description used for archives and SEO.

canonical_url.description: URL of the original source of the content.

tools.name: buttondown_update_email_draft
tools.title: Edit an email draft
tools.description: WRITE: edit the subject, body, description, slug or preview image of an email that is still a DRAFT (replaces those fields; the previous text is lost unless Buttondown's email history is used). Refuses any email that is not a draft, and never changes status or publish date, so nothing is sent or scheduled. PATCH /emails/{id}.

email_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

body.description: New body in Markdown (or HTML); replaces the whole body.

tools.name: buttondown_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List subscriber tags with name, color, descriptions and whether subscribers can edit them. GET /tags.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_get_tag_analytics
tools.title: Get tag analytics
tools.description: Subscribers created, open rate and click rate for one tag. GET /tags/{id}/analytics.

tools.name: buttondown_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: WRITE: create a subscriber tag (needs a Buttondown plan with tags). An existing tag with the same name is returned as an error and not changed. POST /tags.

public_description.description: Public description shown in the subscriber portal.

subscriber_editable.description: Let subscribers add/remove this tag themselves. Default false.

tools.name: buttondown_list_automations
tools.title: List automations
tools.description: List automations (welcome sequences and other triggered e-mails) with name, status, trigger, actions and filters (webhook URLs in actions are shown by host only). Read-only: automations are not started or changed. GET /automations.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_get_automation
tools.title: Get automation
tools.description: One automation by id with its trigger, actions and filters. GET /automations/{id}.

automation_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

tools.name: buttondown_get_automation_analytics
tools.title: Get automation analytics
tools.description: Performance numbers for one automation. GET /automations/{id}/analytics.

automation_id.description: The object's Buttondown id (a UUID or a prefixed id such as em_..., sub_..., tag_...).

tools.name: buttondown_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List surveys with question, answers, status and response count. GET /surveys.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List survey responses (who answered what), optionally for one survey, email or subscriber. GET /survey_responses.

email_id.description: Only responses submitted from this email.

subscriber_id.description: Only responses by this subscriber (id, not e-mail).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List saved subscriber segments with name, description and filters. GET /segments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List sign-up forms with title, slug, status, tags and subscriber counts. GET /forms.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_snippets
tools.title: List snippets
tools.description: List reusable content snippets with identifier, name, mode and how often each is referenced. GET /snippets.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List configured webhooks with status and subscribed event types. The signing key is never returned and the URL is shown by host only. GET /webhooks.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: buttondown_list_events
tools.title: List email events
tools.description: List delivery events (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, ...), newest first, optionally for one email or subscriber. GET /events.

subscriber_id.description: Only events for this subscriber (id, not e-mail).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
